description: After the disastrous Sardinian War, Franz's grief and infidelity push Elisabeth away from Vienna. Her island refuge brings her closer to Hungarian revolutionary Count Andrássy, while Maximilian and Marie look toward Mexico. Elisabeth must weigh her own freedom against her family and an empire in crisis.

s03e01.description: Franz returns from the disastrous Sardinian War haunted by the thousands of men lost under his command. Elisabeth tries to reach the husband she remembers, but his guilt and emotional withdrawal collide with a Viennese court that expects its emperor to project unwavering authority, leaving their marriage more fragile than ever.

s03e02.description: Franz's growing distance and infidelity compound Elisabeth's struggle to be heard at court. As the pressure takes a toll on her health, she seeks refuge far from Vienna on an island, where an escape from imperial protocol offers a chance to recover and to question how much of herself the Habsburg marriage has demanded.

s03e03.description: Elisabeth's desire to preserve her family clashes with the obligations that have made her private life a matter of imperial policy. Away from the palace, meeting Hungarian revolutionary Count Andrássy brings the grievances of the empire's subjects into sharp personal focus and challenges her understanding of loyalty, belonging and duty.

s03e04.description: Elisabeth's journey beyond Vienna turns into more than a retreat from illness and an unhappy marriage: her growing affinity with Andrássy exposes the political stakes of Hungary's struggle for recognition. Elsewhere, Maximilian and Marie's plans for a Mexican throne carry Habsburg ambitions across the sea, promising independence but also uncertainty.

s03e05.description: With the imperial marriage stretched close to breaking point, Elisabeth is drawn to the possibility of a life chosen for love rather than duty. Franz seeks solace outside their relationship, while Andrássy's cause forces Elisabeth to consider whether her private longing for freedom can be separated from the future of the people she represents.

s03e06.description: War has left Franz burdened by guilt, the imperial marriage is fractured, and Elisabeth's bond with Andrássy has turned personal longing into a question of political allegiance. As Maximilian and Marie look toward their new future in Mexico, Elisabeth confronts the defining choice of her reign: what she owes her heart, her family and the people of the empire.
